caption: The drawing features a single, transparent glass pitcher positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The pitcher is rendered in light greenish-blue tones, with shading and contour lines suggesting its opacity and thickness. It has a wide mouth with a lip for pouring, a gently curving neck, and a bulbous body that tapers towards the base. The handle, also made of glass, is attached on the right side and features a curved form with a slight decorative element at the lower connection point. The base of the pitcher is flared and features a scalloped, circular design, depicted with dark green shading to indicate depth and texture. There are no other objects or decorations in the composition, and a small, cursive signature appears in black ink below and to the right of the pitcher.
title: Glass Water Pitcher
